thread:
maria: FYI the release cut is on hold. Registry rejected the image manifest during push from CI (400 content-length mismatch). deploy-bot set the promote to HOLD.

maria: Error looks like the registry returned a truncated blob during the manifest commit. Not sure if this is the registry or the runner streaming the blob.

ci-bot: [automated] push-step failed: registry responded 400 Bad Request (error: content-length mismatch). See job 9902: https://ci.internal/9902/logs

jon: Which ref was being promoted? Can we fallback to the last known-good artifact?

maria: We attempted to promote redwood/web@2026-03-25-rc5. Last-known-good is redwood/web@2026-03-23-rc4.

release-manager: We have the weekly change window at 22:00UTC. If we can't get a clean promote before then I'd rather pin to rc4 and proceed with post-release verification.

ops-oncall: I'm checking the registry cluster now. Not seeing obvious OOMs but a few ingress 502 spikes in us-central at 18:42UTC. Rolling a lightweight restart of the registry pods to clear any stuck chunked uploads.

jon: Can we also check runner disk pressure and Docker daemon logs on the runner that pushed? If the tar was truncated locally that could produce this.

maria: The runner was buildkite-agent-21. I can ssh in and fetch the runner upload logs + /var/lib/docker/overlay2 size.

ci-bot: job 9902 (rerun) queued after registry restart.

maria: Given the change window, I'm inclined to manual pin now. We can reopen a promotion once we confirm fix; we shouldn't block the window for a racey registry.

jon: +1 pin. Avoids customer impact. We'll include a note in release notes about rc5 failing manifest push and that rc4 was promoted as a safety.

maria: Executing promote: /promote redwood/web@2026-03-23-rc4 --reason "manual pin: failed registry manifest push for rc5"

deploy-bot: Promotion queued. Running pre-promotion validations.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete  redwood/web@2026-03-23-rc4 has been promoted to candidate. Release notes appended: "Pinned to last-known-good after registry manifest push failure on newer build."

ci-bot: job 9902 (rerun) finished: SUCCESS. Push succeeded on rerun; manifest accepted.

maria: Rerun succeeded, but we've already pinned for the change window. We'll schedule a controlled re-promote after the window if ops confirms registry stability.

ops-oncall: I'll keep the registry under watch for the next 4 hours and collect logs/traces if it reoccurs. If it does, we'll escalate to infra.

jon: I'll open ISSUE-1002: investigate intermittent registry manifest rejects (include runner-21 logs, registry pod logs, ingress traces). Assigning to infra and release eng.

maria: Filed ISSUE-1002 and attached artifacts. Thanks all. We'll coordinate any re-promote in this thread. :thumbsup:
